problem.title: Check Whether Every Internal Node Has Exactly One Child
problem.problemStatement: Given a binary tree, determine whether every internal node has exactly one child.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The next N lines describe the binary tree.
problem.output: • Print YES if every internal node has exactly one child; otherwise print NO.
